sample_locations_or_reach: 283 ITIs statewide as of the 2025 admissions prospectus (63 government + 220 private), spread across all Telangana districts including Hyderabad, Warangal, Karimnagar, Nalgonda and Khammam.
skills_offered_summary: DGT Craftsmen Training Scheme (CTS) trades: Electrician, Fitter, Welder, Mechanic Motor Vehicle, COPA (Computer Operator & Programming Assistant), Diesel Mechanic, Turner, and other engineering/non-engineering trades; admission generally requires SSC (10th) pass or equivalent.
certification_pathways: NCVET-recognized National Trade Certificate (NTC) awarded after the DGT/NCVET All India Trade Test (AITT); trades are NSQF-level mapped and recognized for government/PSU technical recruitment.
data_source: Telangana State ITI Admissions Prospectus 2025, Government of Telangana
notes: [sample_locations_or_reach]: figure (283 total; 63 govt/220 private) is drawn from the 2025 admissions prospectus; a 2026 prospectus PDF exists at the same domain (assets/pdf2026/Prospectus_2026.pdf) but was not directly parsed for an updated count in this pass, so the 2025 figure is used as the most recently confirmed count.

sample_locations_or_reach: 83 government ITIs statewide per a November 2023 state-government modernization announcement (part of a combined 83 ITI + 87 polytechnic + 26 skill-college upgrade programme); additional private ITIs also operate. Visakhapatnam ITI Cluster was selected as India's first PM-SETU pilot cluster (reported 2025-26).
skills_offered_summary: DGT Craftsmen Training Scheme (CTS) trades broadly matching the national ITI curriculum: Electrician, Fitter, Welder, Mechanic Motor Vehicle, COPA, and other engineering/non-engineering trades. Government ITIs in AP reported approximately 98% seat utilisation in 2024-25 per state skilling data cited in press coverage.
certification_pathways: NCVET-recognized National Trade Certificate (NTC) via DGT/NCVET All India Trade Test (AITT); NSQF-aligned.
data_source: Careers360 news reporting on AP government's Rs 100 crore ITI/polytechnic/skill-college modernization announcement (Nov 2023) and AP PM-SETU/Vizag ITI Cluster coverage (2026)
notes: [sample_locations_or_reach]: exact current government-ITI count could not be confirmed via a directly loaded iti.ap.gov.in or labour.ap.gov.in page -- WebFetch to .ap.gov.in domains returned blocked/403 in this environment. The 83-institute figure is from a Nov 2023 news report citing an official state announcement and may have changed since; treat as approximate pending direct department confirmation.

sample_locations_or_reach: Secondary sources give inconsistent statewide totals (approximately 92 to 128 government + private polytechnics combined); institutions are spread across Hyderabad, Warangal, Nizamabad and Karimnagar among other districts. The authoritative current count is the TG POLYCET participating-college list published annually by SBTET Telangana.
skills_offered_summary: Three-year engineering diploma programmes: Civil, Mechanical, Electrical & Electronics, Electronics & Communication, Computer Science, and Automobile Engineering.
certification_pathways: SBTET Telangana diploma certification, NSQF-aligned; lateral entry into B.Tech (2nd year) via TG ECET.
data_source: Aggregated secondary reporting (Careers360, JNTU Fast Result, SmartUpdate24) citing SBTET Telangana POLYCET participating-college data
notes: [sample_locations_or_reach]: sources disagree substantially on the exact total (92, 120 and 128 are all cited across different education portals); WebFetch to sbtet.telangana.gov.in / polycet.sbtet.telangana.gov.in was not possible in this environment (gov.in-adjacent domain restrictions), so no single authoritative figure could be directly confirmed. Treat the range as approximate pending direct SBTET confirmation.

sample_locations_or_reach: AP POLYCET 2026 counselling covered 88 government polytechnic colleges (other secondary sources cite figures ranging from 29 to 84 government colleges, and a combined total of roughly 180 government + private); locations include Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Guntur, Tirupati and Kurnool.
skills_offered_summary: Three-year engineering diploma programmes: Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics & Communication, Computer Science, and Automobile Engineering; SBTET AP regulates the fee structure for government colleges (reported government-seat capacity of roughly 29,000).
certification_pathways: SBTET Andhra Pradesh diploma certification, NSQF-aligned; lateral entry into B.Tech via AP ECET.
data_source: Secondary reporting on AP POLYCET 2026 counselling data; CollegeDekho/Collegedunia aggregation
notes: [sample_locations_or_reach]: secondary sources give inconsistent totals (88 government per 2026 POLYCET counselling vs. 29 or ~84 government cited elsewhere, and ~180 total including ~147 private in another source); WebFetch to sbtet.ap.gov.in was not possible in this environment (gov.in-adjacent domain restrictions). Treat the count as approximate pending direct SBTET AP confirmation.

sample_locations_or_reach: Masab Tank, Hyderabad, Telangana -- a single flagship campus (not a multi-location network).
skills_offered_summary: NBA-accredited three-year diploma programmes across Civil, Mechanical, Computer Science, Automobile, Electronics & Communication, Electrical & Electronics, and Pharmacy engineering; one of the oldest polytechnics in the state, established 1923 (originally with Electrical & Mechanical disciplines).
certification_pathways: SBTET Telangana diploma certification; NBA accreditation for select programmes; NSQF-aligned; lateral entry to B.Tech via TG ECET.
data_source: Institution's official Telangana DTE-hosted website (via search snippet); corroborated by Wikipedia and education-portal listings (CollegeDekho, UniversityKart)
notes: [official_website]: hosted on a *.telangana.gov.in subdomain; direct WebFetch to gov.in-adjacent domains returned blocked/403 in this environment, so content is based on search-result snippets and secondary corroboration (Wikipedia, CollegeDekho, UniversityKart) rather than a directly rendered official page.

provider_name: Engineering Colleges -- AICTE Community College Scheme (Vocational Add-on Programmes)
sample_locations_or_reach: AICTE-approved engineering/technical institutions nationwide may opt into the scheme; the clearest documented implementation found is Assam Engineering Institute (approved for Automobile-Vehicle Testing and Construction-Building Technology, Level I/II, 100 seats per level). The scheme is structurally open to eligible AICTE-approved institutions in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh, though no specific TG/AP institutional adopter was directly confirmed in this research pass.
skills_offered_summary: Short-cycle, NSQF-aligned vocational certificate/diploma add-on trades delivered using existing engineering-college infrastructure, e.g. automobile vehicle testing and building/construction technology.
certification_pathways: AICTE-approved Community College certificate/diploma, NSQF-level-mapped; can feed into further diploma/degree pathways within the AICTE technical-education framework.
data_source: AICTE official website; National Skills Network summary of AICTE skill-development initiatives; Assam Engineering Institute scheme page as illustrative implementation
notes: [sample_locations_or_reach]: no Telangana- or Andhra Pradesh-specific institution running the AICTE Community College Scheme was directly confirmed; row documents a genuine, currently-existing national AICTE scheme that TG/AP engineering colleges are eligible to join, using the best-documented national example (Assam Engineering Institute) as an illustration rather than a TG/AP-located instance.

provider_name: National Skill Training Institutes (NSTI) & NSTI (Women) Network -- DGT
sample_locations_or_reach: 14 NSTIs and 19 NSTI(W)s function across India under the Directorate General of Training (DGT). Hyderabad hosts three campuses: NSTI (Women) Hyderabad at ATI Campus, Vidya Nagar; NSTI Hyderabad-1; and NSTI Hyderabad-2 (Vidya Nagar).
skills_offered_summary: Craft Instructor Training Scheme (CITS) for training ITI instructors, Advanced Vocational Training Scheme (AVTS), and various advanced technical/vocational trade courses; also delivers entrepreneurship-oriented need-based training.
certification_pathways: DGT-issued CITS/AVTS certificates recognized under the NCVET framework; CITS graduates form the instructor cadre feeding into the national ITI network.
data_source: DGT and NSTI institutional websites (nstiwhyderabad.dgt.gov.in, nstihyderabad2.dgt.gov.in, dgt.gov.in) via search snippets
notes: [official_website / source_url]: dgt.gov.in and its NSTI subdomains are Government of India domains; direct WebFetch was blocked (403) in this environment, so facts are drawn from search-engine snippets of these official pages rather than a direct page load.

sample_locations_or_reach: Hyderabad, Telangana (single university under a Public-Private Partnership Act); statewide reach as Telangana's dedicated skill university.
skills_offered_summary: 17 identified priority sectors including Pharma, Construction, Banking & Financial Services, E-Commerce & Logistics, Retail, and Animation/VFX/Gaming; reported to offer 17 courses and train around 20,000 people annually.
certification_pathways: University-awarded diplomas/degrees under the Young India Skills University, Telangana (Public-Private Partnership) Act 2024; industry-aligned curricula co-designed with private-sector partners.
data_source: Telangana State Portal press releases (2024); The South First and Deccan Chronicle news coverage of the enabling Assembly bill
notes: [skills_offered_summary]: '17 courses / 20,000 trained per year' figure is from a July 2024 Telangana State Portal press release near the university's founding; a direct WebFetch of yisu.in was not performed to reconfirm current-year figures, so this should be treated as an early-stage baseline rather than the latest annual figure.

provider_name: TASK -- Telangana Academy for Skill and Knowledge
sample_locations_or_reach: Headquartered in Hyderabad; delivers programmes through partner engineering colleges across Telangana in collaboration with IIIT-Hyderabad, NIT Warangal, IIT Hyderabad and BITS Pilani.
skills_offered_summary: Technology skilling in collaboration with Oracle, Infosys, Google, IBM, Microsoft, Autodesk and SAP; Personal Impact Skills, Organization Impact Skills and Technical Skills; sector programmes such as a Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages tie-up to skill 10,000 unemployed youth and a Cotelligent partnership for cybersecurity training/placement.
certification_pathways: Industry-partner certificates (Oracle, Microsoft, SAP, etc.) delivered through TASK-run bootcamps and college tie-ups; not a single standalone TASK certification but a facilitation/aggregation model.
data_source: Vikaspedia best-practices profile of TASK; Telangana IT Department (it.telangana.gov.in) initiative page; Telangana Web Directory
notes: [official_website]: task.telangana.gov.in is a Government of Telangana domain; direct WebFetch was blocked in this environment, so facts rely on search snippets of the official site plus the Vikaspedia and it.telangana.gov.in secondary profiles.

provider_name: APSSDC -- Andhra Pradesh State Skill Development Corporation
sample_locations_or_reach: Academic and non-academic training centres across all 26 districts of Andhra Pradesh; reported network includes 26 skill colleges and 192 training hubs, with 55 industry partners engaged as 'skill spokes'.
skills_offered_summary: Naipunya Vikasam Schools programme (social/tribal welfare schools), Employability Skill Centres (ESC) at degree and engineering colleges, CM Skill Excellence Centers (with Siemens and Dassault Systemes), ITI-linked training, Youth Training Centres (YTCs), job facilitation and Entrepreneurship Development Programmes (EDP).
certification_pathways: Sector-specific certifications delivered via industry partners (e.g. Siemens, Dassault Systemes) and mapped to NCVET/NSQF-aligned job roles; job placement/facilitation is a core outcome tracked by APSSDC.
data_source: APSSDC official website (via search snippet); Government of Andhra Pradesh district portal (tirupati.ap.gov.in/apssdc); India.gov.in National Portal service listing
notes: [official_website]: apssdc.in and the .ap.gov.in district portal were not directly WebFetch-able in this environment (blocked/403), so the '26 skill colleges / 192 hubs / 55 industry spokes' figures rely on search-result snippets rather than a directly loaded page; treat as a recent but not pinpoint-dated snapshot.

sample_locations_or_reach: Pan-India network; NSDC reports 343 training partners (for-profit and not-for-profit) operating training centres nationwide, including in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.
skills_offered_summary: Cross-sector vocational skilling funded/facilitated through NSDC's Public-Private-Partnership model; flagship delivery channels include Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY) and Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendras (PMKK, see separate row).
certification_pathways: NSDC/Sector Skill Council-aligned NSQF certifications delivered by its training-partner network; certificates are recognized under the PMKVY/NCVET framework.
data_source: NSDC official website (nsdcindia.org/training-partner-0, nsdcindia.org/partners); Wikipedia profile of National Skill Development Corporation

provider_name: Maruti Suzuki Training Academy (MSTA) -- NSDC Training Partner
sample_locations_or_reach: Headquartered in Gurgaon, Haryana; functions as an enterprise/dealer-network training academy for Maruti Suzuki employees, dealers and vendors nationwide, including in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh dealer networks.
skills_offered_summary: Behavioral, technical and functional automotive-sector skilling for Maruti Suzuki's employee, dealer and vendor ecosystem; complements the separate Automobile Skill Enhancement Centres (ASEC) programme run in government ITIs (see corporate-academy row).
certification_pathways: Maruti Suzuki/NSDC-aligned internal certification recognized within the Maruti Suzuki dealer and service ecosystem; feeds automotive-sector employability outcomes.
data_source: Maruti Suzuki official corporate website; Youth4work institutional profile
notes: [sample_locations_or_reach]: MSTA's core campus is in Gurgaon (Haryana), outside Telangana/Andhra Pradesh; it is included here as a genuinely real, well-documented NSDC training-partner example (per task instructions to cite a real example partner) rather than a TG/AP-headquartered body -- its national dealer/vendor training reach does extend into both states.

sample_locations_or_reach: 812 PMKKs allocated across 36 states/UTs and 707 districts nationally, with 738 established as of recent MSDE/NSDC reporting; within Telangana, PMKK centres are concentrated in Hyderabad, Warangal, Karimnagar and Nalgonda districts, run by private implementation partners contracted through NSDC.
skills_offered_summary: Short-term (typically 300-600 hour) free skill-training batches under the Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY), spanning multiple sector job roles at model, branded training centres.
certification_pathways: NSQF-aligned Sector Skill Council certification issued on completion of PMKVY short-term training and assessment; searchable via the Skill India Digital Hub.
data_source: MSDE official PMKK scheme page; IMPRI India policy-update brief on PMKKs (2025); YouthPower India institutional listing for Hyderabad PMKK
notes: [sample_locations_or_reach]: an exact current count of PMKKs specifically within Telangana or Andhra Pradesh (as opposed to the national 812-allocated/738-established figures) was not found in a single authoritative source; the TG district concentration (Hyderabad/Warangal/Karimnagar/Nalgonda) is drawn from a secondary aggregator (YouthPower India) rather than an official state-wise MSDE table.

provider_name: NPTEL -- National Programme on Technology Enhanced Learning
sample_locations_or_reach: Pan-India online; courses developed by 7 IITs (Bombay, Delhi, Kanpur, Kharagpur, Madras, Guwahati, Roorkee) plus IISc Bangalore, accessible to learners anywhere including Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.
skills_offered_summary: Engineering, science, humanities and skill-based courses across disciplines; free enrollment with certification available for a nominal proctored-exam fee (~Rs 1,000).
certification_pathways: NPTEL certificate (via SWAYAM's NC framework) after passing a proctored exam plus weekly assignments; over 500 Indian colleges reportedly grant academic credit transfer for completed NPTEL courses.
data_source: NPTEL official 'About Us' page; SWAYAM NPTEL course-provider listing

provider_name: SWAYAM -- Study Webs of Active-Learning for Young Aspiring Minds
sample_locations_or_reach: Pan-India online; developed by AICTE (2016/2017 launch window) and hosts courses from IITs, IIMs, central universities and IGNOU, covering school (class 9+) through postgraduate and skill-based courses.
skills_offered_summary: Over 2,000 free online courses across academic and vocational/skill subjects; up to 20% credit transfer permitted toward a learner's degree programme at participating Indian universities.
certification_pathways: SWAYAM certificate issued on payment of a nominal certification fee and passing requirements; government-recognized and credit-transferable under UGC guidelines.
data_source: AICTE official SWAYAM bureau page; SWAYAM official website

provider_name: Siemens Centres of Excellence (COE) -- Andhra Pradesh (APSSDC Partnership)
sample_locations_or_reach: Six Centres of Excellence established across Andhra Pradesh under a Siemens Industry Software-APSSDC agreement, embedded within the state's broader skill-centre/hub network spanning its 26 districts; exact city-level COE addresses were not confirmed in this research pass.
skills_offered_summary: Automotive, Industrial Machinery, Industrial Automation, Aerospace & Defence, and Shipbuilding skilling, alongside broader Technical-Skill Development Institutes (t-SDIs) covering Automotive, Electrician, Electronics, Manufacturing & Fabrication, and Agro & Farm Machinery trades at polytechnic/ITI level.
certification_pathways: Siemens-certified industry credentials in CAD/CAM/PLM and automation tooling, delivered alongside NSQF-aligned polytechnic/ITI qualifications through the APSSDC partnership.
data_source: Siemens official press release on India skill-upgradation initiatives
notes: [sample_locations_or_reach]: the Siemens press release confirms 'six Centers of Excellence' under the APSSDC agreement and lists the five-plus sector focus areas, but does not name the specific host towns/campuses; city-level locations could not be independently confirmed in this pass and are marked here as a gap rather than fabricated.

provider_name: Maruti Suzuki Automobile Skill Enhancement Centres (ASEC)
sample_locations_or_reach: 31 ASEC locations set up inside government ITIs across India as of recent CSR reporting; part of a cumulative Maruti Suzuki vocational-training/CSR investment exceeding Rs 450 crore (as of FY2024-25). Specific Telangana/Andhra Pradesh ASEC sites were not individually confirmed in this pass.
skills_offered_summary: Automotive servicing and repair trades embedded in government ITI curricula: Mechanic Motor Vehicle (MMV), Auto Body Repair (ABR) and Auto Body Paint (ABP).
certification_pathways: DGT/NCVET-recognized ITI trade certification (NTC) in the relevant automotive trade, delivered through the host government ITI with Maruti Suzuki-provided equipment, curriculum inputs and instructor training.
data_source: Maruti Suzuki official CSR/ITI-upgradation page; CSRBox news coverage of the ASEC initiative
notes: [sample_locations_or_reach]: the 31-location figure and cumulative Rs 450 crore CSR investment are from Maruti Suzuki's own CSR reporting; an earlier CSRBox report cited 15 ITIs, suggesting the network expanded over time. No specific Telangana or Andhra Pradesh ASEC host-ITI was confirmed by name in this research pass.

sample_locations_or_reach: Headquartered in Chennai, Tamil Nadu; operates a franchised network variously reported as 250+ to 400+ training centres across India (plus several other countries), including branches in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh cities, though an exact TG/AP branch list was not directly confirmed in this pass.
skills_offered_summary: CAD/CAM/CAE software training -- AutoCAD, CATIA, SolidWorks, Revit and related design/engineering software tools for mechanical, civil, architecture and manufacturing applications.
certification_pathways: CADD Centre's own ISO 9001:2015-certified proprietary certification, industry-recognized within CAD/design-services employers; not an NCVET/NSQF-awarded credential.
data_source: CADD Centre official corporate website and network page
notes: [sample_locations_or_reach]: reported centre counts vary between sources (250+ vs 400+); specific Telangana/Andhra Pradesh branch locations were not individually verified in this research pass, though CADD Centre is confirmed to operate a large pan-India franchise network that plausibly includes both states.

sample_locations_or_reach: Pan-India footprint (NIIT reports presence in 30+ countries); operates NIIT Skilling/Career Development Centres and NIIT Foundation IT Foundation Centres in tier-3 towns nationally; specific Telangana/Andhra Pradesh centre locations were not individually confirmed in this pass.
skills_offered_summary: IT and digital skilling: Full Stack development, Data Science, Generative AI, Digital Marketing and Cybersecurity, alongside foundational digital-literacy and employability courses (personality development, communication, work etiquette) via NIIT Foundation centres.
certification_pathways: NIIT's own industry-recognized certification tracks (e.g. in software development and digital skills); NIIT Foundation programmes are oriented toward NSDC/PMKVY-aligned livelihood outcomes for underserved learners.
data_source: NIIT official corporate website; NIIT Foundation official website
notes: [sample_locations_or_reach]: specific Telangana/Andhra Pradesh NIIT or NIIT Foundation centre locations were not individually verified in this research pass; included as a genuine, long-established national private IT-training provider per the task's private-institute category.

sample_locations_or_reach: Pan-India online; reports over 10 million learners globally and 300+ hiring partners, accessible to learners in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh alongside the rest of India.
skills_offered_summary: Over 500 courses and 50 specializations spanning AI, data science, marketing, business administration, cloud computing, management, technology, law and humanities.
certification_pathways: upGrad-issued certificates plus university-partnered degrees (e.g. MBAs with Liverpool Business School, Golden Gate University, O.P. Jindal Global University) and industry micro-credentials.
data_source: upGrad official website and About Us page

sample_locations_or_reach: Pan-India online platform, a public-private partnership between the Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology (MeitY) and NASSCOM, accessible to learners in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.
skills_offered_summary: Digital-technology upskilling in AI, data analytics, cloud computing, cybersecurity and other emerging tech areas, delivered with partners including Microsoft, AWS and Cisco.
certification_pathways: FutureSkills Prime/partner-issued digital-technology certifications; government incentives (cashback up to Rs 14,500 reported) are available for eligible completions under the scheme.
data_source: FutureSkills Prime official website (About Us, Govt of India Incentives pages); Digital India (MeitY) initiative page; NIELIT official reference

sample_locations_or_reach: Pan-India online (single national government portal); accessible to learners, training providers and assessment agencies in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh as elsewhere.
skills_offered_summary: Unified digital interface for skilling-course discovery, digital enrolment, assessment and certification; interlinks Udyam, e-Shram, National Career Service (NCS) and ASEEM portals for candidate, training-provider and employer services.
certification_pathways: Digitally verifiable and portable NCVET/NSQF-aligned skill credentials issued across linked schemes (e.g. PMKVY) via the SIDH platform.
data_source: PIB (Press Information Bureau) official press release on Skill India Digital Hub; India.gov.in National Portal service listing
notes: [official_website]: skillindiadigital.gov.in is a Government of India gov.in domain; direct WebFetch was blocked in this environment, so facts are drawn from the PIB press release and India.gov.in National Portal listing rather than a directly loaded page.

sample_locations_or_reach: Hyderabad, Telangana; part of NIELIT's national network of regional/extension centres under the Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology (MeitY).
skills_offered_summary: IT-literacy and electronics/IT courses including 'O' Level and 'A' Level programmes (DOEACC/NIELIT scheme), digital-literacy courses (e.g. CCC), and participation in national digital-skilling initiatives such as FutureSkills Prime.
certification_pathways: NIELIT 'O'/'A'/'B'/'C' Level certificates, recognized by the Government of India as equivalent to certain foundational/degree-level qualifications in computer applications for specific purposes (e.g. government recruitment eligibility).
data_source: NIELIT official website (Hyderabad centre page)
notes: [official_website]: nielit.gov.in is a Government of India gov.in domain; direct WebFetch was blocked in this environment, so facts rely on search-result snippets and general knowledge of the well-documented NIELIT O/A-Level scheme rather than a directly loaded Hyderabad-centre page.

sample_locations_or_reach: Single flagship campus on a 46.46-acre site in Madhapur, Hitech City, Hyderabad, Telangana; established 1998 under the auspices of the (undivided) Andhra Pradesh state government and now situated in Telangana following the 2014 state bifurcation.
skills_offered_summary: Construction-sector skilling and skill-upgradation for unemployed youth and existing workers (short-term, medium-term and long-term courses), plus postgraduate-level programmes in Project Management.
certification_pathways: NAC's own diploma/certificate programmes in construction trades and project management; short-term construction-worker skilling outcomes are also linked to the state Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board ecosystem.
data_source: Wikipedia profile of National Academy of Construction; Shiksha institutional listing; nacbocwb.cgg.gov.in (AP/Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board-linked domain)
notes: [jurisdiction]: NAC was established in 1998 under combined (pre-bifurcation) Andhra Pradesh; its Hyderabad campus is now within Telangana post-2014 bifurcation, so it is classified here under Telangana jurisdiction while noting the institution's historical AP origin. [provider_type]: classified as Government Skill Body given its origin under state-government auspices and its linkage to a state welfare-board domain (nacbocwb.cgg.gov.in), though it functions operationally much like an autonomous training institute.

sample_locations_or_reach: Pan-India; DGT (Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship) is the central regulator/administrator for the national ITI network, NSTIs, and apprenticeship training, with jurisdiction covering Telangana and Andhra Pradesh ITIs/NSTIs alongside the rest of India.
skills_offered_summary: Regulates and standardizes the Craftsmen Training Scheme (CTS) delivered by ITIs nationwide, the Craft Instructor Training Scheme (CITS) delivered by NSTIs, and apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, 1961.
certification_pathways: DGT-administered National Trade Certificate (NTC) via the All India Trade Test (AITT), and National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) for completed apprenticeships; both recognized under the NCVET/NSQF framework.
data_source: DGT and NSTI institutional websites (via search snippets); cross-referenced against NSTI Hyderabad campus pages
notes: [official_website]: dgt.gov.in is a Government of India gov.in domain; direct WebFetch was blocked in this environment, so facts are drawn from search-engine snippets of DGT and NSTI subdomain pages rather than a directly loaded page.
